locations.title: Lost Woods Secret Cave Entrance
locations.description: Lift up the center bush and drop down.

locations.title: Lost Woods Secret Cave Exit
locations.description: The secret entrance is nearby, under the cluster of bushes.

locations.title: Kakariko Well (Secret Cave Entrance)
locations.description:
**Location: **Northwest Kakariko Village

Drop into the opening from the ledge above. Contains five Chests with 60 Rupees and bomb refills, as well as a Piece of Heart.

locations.title: Kakariko Cave Exit
locations.description: The upper portion of the cave can only be accessed via the well to the west.

locations.title: Desert of Mystery Cave
locations.description: Cave entrance that leads to Aginah and a Piece of Heart

locations.title: Lake Hylia Secret Ice Cave Entrance
locations.description: Bomb the wall to enter the cave.

locations.title: Secret Rupee Cave
locations.description: Life the stone slab to enter. The Blue Rupees in the pots respawn when you exit, making this the best money-farming spot in the game.

locations.title: North Hyrule Fairy Fountain Cave
locations.description: This cave opening is one-way only -- you can exit here from the Fairy Fountain.

locations.title: Death Mountain Access Cave
locations.description: Leads to: [Kakariko Village Access Path](#loc=429770)

locations.title: Return Passage from Death Mountain
locations.description: Connects to (one-way): [Return Passage to Kakariko Village Entrance](#loc=429768)

locations.title: Return Passage to Kakariko Village
locations.description: Leads to: [Return Passage from Death Mountain](#loc=429767)

locations.title: The Mountain Cave
locations.description: Leads to: [Mountain Cave (Upper Exit)](#loc=429771)

locations.title: Death Mountain Access Ave (Kakariko Village Return Path)
locations.description: Leads to: [Death Mountain Access Path](#loc=429766)

locations.title: The Mountain Cave (Upper Exit)
locations.description: Leads to: [Mountain Cave](#loc=429769)

locations.title: Death Mountain Fairy Cave
locations.description: While not a true Fairy Fountain, there is a cave here with small fairies you can catch.

locations.title: Ice Lake Fairy Fountain Cave
locations.description: Bomb the wall to enter

locations.title: Hollow Tree Cave and Fairy Fountain Exit
locations.description: Enter through the [Hollow Tree Cave Secret Entrance](#loc=430050) to get to the Piece of Heart and Small Fairy Fountain inside.

locations.title: Hollow Tree Cave Secret Entrance
locations.description:
**Requirement:** Defeated Agahnim in the Hyrule Castle Tower

Open up this secret entrance by slamming into the tree with your Pegasus Boots.

locations.title: Desert Plateau Cave
locations.description:
**Location:** Light World, accessible only via Magic Mirror from the Dark World

The cave contains pots and a Piece of Heart.

locations.title: East Death Mountain Cave
locations.description: Area behind the block is accessible from the top entrance on the summit of Death Mountain. Drop into a pit to land here, then bomb to the wall to access the two treasure rooms nearby.

locations.title: Plains of Ruin Cave
locations.description: Bomb the wall to open the passage

locations.title: Mad Batter Cave
locations.description: Exit only

locations.title: Mad Batter Cave (Secret Entrance)
locations.description: Fall into the opening to enter

locations.title: Graveyard Cave
locations.description: Access by using the Magic Mirror in the equivalent spot in the Dark World

locations.title: The Cave
locations.description: Called just "The Cave" on the nearby sign, this Dark World equivalent to Sanctuary is home to the Storyteller Octopus who will give you a hint for 20 Rupees.

locations.title: Tree Trunk Cave
locations.description: Pound down all the pegs to open up a hidden passage in the tree trunk.

locations.title: Desert Heart Cave
locations.description: Access via the Dark World. Lift the stone slab.

locations.title: Swamp of Evil Storyteller Cave
locations.description: Contains Storyteller and a bombable wall with a hidden room and pots.

locations.title: Death Mountain Dark World Treasure Cave
locations.description: You'll need to the Magic Cape, Hammer, and Titan's Mitt for this one.

locations.title: Lake Hylia Treasure Cave
locations.description: Receive 300 Rupees from the thief in this hideout, as well as additional refills and Rupees from four chests inside.

locations.title: Lake Hylia Thief's Hideout
locations.description: A thief is guarding four pots with Blue Rupees and offers up advice: "You can earn a lot of Rupees by defeating enemies. It's the secret of my success..."

locations.title: Ice Lake Hint Cave
locations.description: Hint tablet: Link, di you know that if you destroy frozen enemies with the Hammer, you will often get a Magic Decanter?"

locations.title: Storyteller Hand
locations.description: Pay 20 Rupees for a hint. The Hand tells you it was a thief in the Light World and that a master locksmith went into hiding: the strange midde-aged guy.

locations.title: Death Mountain Shop Cave
locations.description: Bomb the wall on the northwest side to access the shop

locations.title: Spectacle Rock Cave (Lower Left Entrance)
locations.description: Drop down to this entrance from above and follow the cave to the Spectacle Rock Fairy Fountain

locations.title: Spectacle Rock Cave
locations.description: Hookshot over the pit to the plaque -- or drop down to the Fairy Fountain walkway.

locations.title: Death Mountain Dark World Fairy Fountain Cave
East Death Mountain Cave (Upper Entrance)
locations.description: Drop into the pit to access the area with the bombable exit to the [Treasure Chests (2)](#loc=430183) below. Take the stairs to get to the [Treasure Chests (5)](#loc=430184).

locations.title: Death Mountain Treasure Cave (Upper Entrance)
locations.description: Narrow cave passage with Mini-Moldorms and Bari that leads to a pit. Pit leads to a treasure chest on a platform containing 50 Rupees. See: [Treasure Chest (1)](#loc=430185)

locations.title: East Death Mountain Dark World Cave
locations.description: Follow the path and take the stairs to get to the two chests. See: [Treasure Chest (2)](#loc=431499)

locations.title: East Death Mountain Dark World Cave (Lower Entrance)
locations.description: Follow the left path (the narrow path dead-ends in blocks). Drop into the pit blocking the path to get beyond the blocks. Push the left block up and take the stairs up. Fall into the right pit to get beyond the other two blocks. Take the stairs up to an area with Hardhat Beetles and three pits. All three drop down to the block puzzle and treasure chests. See: [Treasure Chest (2)](#loc=431499)

locations.title: Turtle Rock (West Cave Entrance)
locations.description: Accessible only from within the Turtle Rock dungeon.

locations.title: Death Mountain Piece of Heart Cave
locations.description: Accessible only via the Dark World [Transition Point](#loc=439896).

locations.title: Fairy
locations.description: Cut the bushes to release a Fairy (refills your hearts, can be caught)

locations.title: Turtle Rock Fairy Room
locations.description:
Type: Small Fairy Room

A single fairy floats in the room north of the tile room. Pick up the pot for a full Magic Energy refill.

locations.title: Ganon's Tower Fairy Room
locations.description:
Type: Small Fairy Room

Smash into the barrier on the third floor walkway with the Pegasus Shoes to knock yourself over to the platform on the other side and then bomb the wall.

Two fairies float in a room.

locations.title: Ganon's Tower Fairy Pit
locations.description:
**Type:** Small Fairy Room

After beating the mini-bosses, head west and through the bombable north wall to find a room with an open pit and four fairies.

locations.title: Fairy
locations.description: Smash into the tree to reveal a fairy

locations.title: Fairy
locations.description: Smash into the tree to release a fairy

locations.title: Fairy
locations.description: Smash into the tree to release a Fairy

locations.title: Fairy
locations.description: Lift the bush to release this Stray Fairy

locations.title: Fairy
locations.description: Dash into the stones to release a stray fairy

locations.title: Fairies
locations.description: Dash into the rocks to release stray fairies

locations.title: Fairies (x2)
locations.description: Inside the Death Mountain Fairy Cave

locations.title: Fairy
locations.description: Smash into the tree with the Pegasus Shoes (early game)

locations.title: Lake Hylia Fairy Fountain
locations.description: **Type:** Small Fairy Fountain

locations.title: Pond of Happiness
locations.description: **Type:** Special Fairy Fountain

locations.title: Lake Hylia Isle Fairy Fountain

Bomb the east wall for a secret room with four fairies.

locations.description: **Type:** Great Fairy Fountain

locations.title: North Hyrule Fairy Fountain
locations.description:
**Type:** Great Fairy Fountain

Lift the bush to find a secret entrance to the Fairy Fountain.

locations.title: Spectacle Rock Fairy Fountain
locations.description:
**Type:** Small Fairy Fountain

**Location:** Inside the Death Mountain Cave

Enter through the [Spectacle Rock Fairy Fountain Cave](#loc=431478) or drop into the hole south of the Sahasrahla plaque and head east to find three fairies you can catch

locations.title: East Hyrule Fairy Fountain
locations.description:
**Type:** Small Fairy Fountain

Catch or use the four small fairies to replenish your health.

locations.title: Central Hyrule Fairy Fountain
locations.description: **Type:** Small Fairy Fountain

locations.title: Eastern Palace Fairy Room
locations.description:
**Type:** Small Fairy Room

Drop into the left vase on 1F.

locations.title: Desert Palace Fairy Fountain
locations.description: **Type:** Small Fairy Fountain

locations.title: Tower of Hera Fairy Fountain
locations.description:
**Type:** Small Fairy Fountain

Fall into the pit on the north wall on the fifth floor and you'll land in this secret room on the first floor.

locations.title: Dark Palace Fairy Fountain
locations.description:
Type: Small Fairy Fountain

Bomb the right wall in this 1F Room

locations.title: Ice Palace Fairy Fountain
locations.description:
Type: Small Fairy Fountain

Located on B5.

locations.title: Great Swamp Fairy Fountain
locations.description: **Type:** Great Fairy Fountain

locations.description: **Type:** Great Fairy Fountain

locations.description: **Type:** Great Fairy Fountain

Also known as the Mysterious Pond

locations.description: **Type:** Special Fairy Fountain

locations.title: Hollow Tree Fairy Fountain
locations.description: **Type:** Small Fairy Fountain

locations.description:
**Type:** Small Fairy Fountain

Smash into the rocks to open up a hidden entrance

locations.title: Ice Lake Fairy Fountain
locations.description: **Type:** Great Fairy Fountain

locations.title: Death Mountain Small Fairy Fountain
locations.description:
**Type:** Small Fairy Fountain

Accessible with the Hookshot

locations.title: Death Mountain Dark World Fairy Fountain
locations.description: Type: Great Fairy

locations.title: Death Mountain Great Fairy Fountain
locations.description:
**Type:** Great Fairy Fountain

Inside Hookshot Cave, bomb the north wall. Go through the door and now bomb the north wall in the next section of the cave as well, a cross-shaped junction.

locations.title: Link's House
locations.description:
Link's House is where Link's adventure starts. Whenever you restart your quest, you can select Link's House as your starting point. Other starting areas are added later in the quest. 

Link's house contains the first item, the Lamp, and three heart refills underneath the pots.

locations.title: Secret Entrance to Hyule Castle Dungeon
locations.description: Pick up the bush and find a secret entrance to drop into.

locations.title: Sanctuary
locations.description: Hyrule's Sanctuary is unlocked as a start destination after completing Hyrule Castle Dungeon and saving Princess Zelda.

locations.title: Swamp Ruins
locations.description: The Swamp Ruins is a small dungeon that contains a lever to drain the water outside.

locations.title: Great Swamp
locations.description: Swamp region in southern Hyrule

locations.title: Eastern Ruins
locations.description: Home to the Eastern Palace and where you meet Sahasrahla to kick off the quest for the Pendants and the Master Sword.

locations.title: Eastern Palace
locations.description: Home of the Pendant of Courage and part of the Light World Master Sword quest.

locations.title: Sahasrahla's Cottage
locations.description:
Location: North Kakariko Village

Meet the Elder's wife to further your quest.

locations.title: Thieves' Hideout
locations.description:
**Location:** North Kakariko Village

Used to be a hideout for a gang of thieves. Contains four chests with red Rupees (80) and a Piece of Heart.

locations.title: Weathercock
locations.description: Play the Flute in front of this weather vane to release the bird inside, which can be summoned to warp around the world.

locations.title: Kakariko Inn
locations.description:
Location: South Kakariko Village

The inn has two entrances -- the back entrance leads to a Bottle.

locations.title: Kakariko Shack
locations.description: Bomb the front wall to enter.

locations.title: Light World Fortune Teller
locations.description: Pay between 10 and 30 Rupees to get a hint. Also refills your hearts.

locations.title: House of Books (Library)
locations.description: Location: South of Kakariko Village

locations.title: Pendant of Power
locations.description: Defeat the Lanmolas

locations.title: Dark Palace
locations.description: Pay Kiki the Monkey 100 Rupees to open the front door

locations.title: Shooting Gallery
locations.description: Archery challenge mini-game. Pay 20 Rupees to win up to 124 Rupees.

locations.title: Sweeping Lady's House
locations.description: House populated by Cuccos

locations.title: Doorless Shack
locations.description: Bomb the opening to enter

locations.title: Overgrown House
locations.description: The man inside provides back story on the missing bird

locations.title: Treasure Chest Game - Dark World
locations.description: Pay 30 Rupees to play and win Rupees or a Piece of Heart

locations.title: Misery Mire
locations.description: Use the Ether Medallion to open the dungeon

locations.title: Ice Palace
locations.description: Access via Light World warp in this spot

locations.title: Lost Woods Treasure Chest Game
locations.description: Pay 100 Rupees to open a chest. You have a one in three chance of winning 300 Rupees.

locations.title: Twin Lumberjacks' Woodsmen's Hut
locations.description: The house of lumberjacks A Bumpkin and B Bumpkin.

locations.title: Hyrule Castle Sewers Treasure Room
locations.description: Access via the tombstone in the graveyard. Bomb one of the two wall openings and find three treasure chests (300 Rupees, Bombs, Arrows) and six pots (4 heart refills).

locations.title: Broken Bridge
locations.description: Cross with Hookshot

locations.title: Death Mountain Bridge
locations.description: Use the Magic Hammer to get past the pegs.

locations.title: Zora's Waterfall
locations.description: Location reachable by exiting to the north of Zora's Domain.

locations.title: Desert Palace Monolith
locations.description: Use the Book of Mudora to read the inscription and open up the dungeon entrance.

locations.title: Witch's Hut
locations.description:
Red Potion: 120 Rupees
Green Potion: 60 Rupees
Blue Potion: 160 Rupees

locations.title: Bomb Shop
locations.description: Purchase 30 Bombs for 100 Rupees

locations.title: Shop
locations.description:
Sells:
* 1x Red Potion (150)
* 1x Blue Shield (50)
* 10x Bombs (50)

locations.title: Lake Hylia Shop
locations.description:
Sells:

* 1x Red Potion (150)
* 1x Heart refill (10)
* 10x Bombs (50)

locations.title: Death Mountain Shop
locations.description:
*Red Potion (150)
*1x Heart refill (10)
*10x Bombs (50)

locations.title: Dark World Specialty Shop
locations.description:
* Red Shield (500)
* Bee (10)
* 10x Arrows (30)

locations.title: Duck Warp
locations.description: Release the duck from the weathercock to unlock it as a warp feature. The duck picks you up anywhere on the map when using the Flute.

locations.title: Dark World Warp
locations.description: Requires Hammer and Power Glove to get to this warp and to the Dark World [Transfer Point](#loc=434766)

locations.title: Dark World Warp
locations.description: The Hyrule Castle entrance becomes a warp after Link defeats Agahnim. It leads to this [Transfer Point](#loc=434764)

locations.title: Dark World Warp
locations.description: This portion of the grove requires the Titan's Mitt to lift the dark stone slab at its entrance

locations.title: Dark World Warp
locations.description: Requires the Magic Hammer to pound down the pegs blocking the way

locations.title: Dark World Warp
locations.description:
Requires the Titan's Mitt to lift the dark rock

Grants access to the Dark World [Transition Point](#loc=434745)

locations.title: Dark World Warp
locations.description: Requires the Flute and the Titan's Mitt to access. Warps to the Dark World's [Transfer Point](#loc=434772)

locations.title: Dark World Warp
locations.description: Requires the Titan's Mitt to access

locations.title: Dark World Warp
locations.description:
This warp point is hidden until you climb up (Titan's Mitt required) and pound down the stakes in this order: bottom-right, top, bottom-left

[1. Pound this peg first](#loc=430161)

[2. Pound this peg second](#loc=430162)

[3. Pound this peg third](#loc=430163)

locations.title: Whirlpool Waterway
locations.description: Swim into it to warp to the [Warp Whirl](#loc=430508) near the northern waterfalls.

locations.title: Whirlpool Waterway
locations.description: Swim into it to warp to the Swamp's [Warp Whirl](#loc=430507).

locations.title: Whirlpool Waterway
locations.description: Swim into the whirlpool to warp to the [Whirlpool Waterway](#loc=430887) near the Waterfall of Wishing.

locations.title: Whirlpool Waterway
locations.description: Swim into the whirlpool to warp to the [Whirlpool Waterway](#loc=430885) in Lake Hylia.

locations.title: Whirlpool Waterway
locations.description: Swim into the whirlpool to warp to the northwest Hyrule [Whirlpool Waterway](#loc=430889).

locations.title: Whirlpool Waterway
locations.description: Swim into the whirlpool to warp to the east Lake Hylia [Whirlpool Waterway](#loc=430888).

locations.title: Whirlpool Waterway
locations.description: Swim into the whirlpool to warp to the Ice Lake's [Whirlpool Waterway](#loc=430891).

locations.title: Whirlpool Waterway
locations.description: Swim into the whirlpool to warp to the Dark World riverlands [Whirlpool Waterway](#loc=430890).

locations.title: Heart Container 1
locations.description:
**Location:** Sanctuary, in a Chest

The first Heart Container Link collects is found in a treasure chest inside Sanctuary.

locations.title: Heart Container 2
locations.description:
**Location:** Boss Chamber, 1F Northern Room

The second Heart Container will upgrade Link's health meter by a full heart. Defeat the Boss to get it.

locations.title: Heart Container 4
locations.description: Defeat Moldorm

locations.title: Heart Container 3
locations.description: Defeat the Lanmolas

locations.title: Heart Container 5
locations.description:
**Location:** Dark Palace B1

Defeat the boss

locations.title: Heart Container 7
locations.description: Defeat Mothula

locations.title: Heart Container 6
locations.description: Defeat Arrghus

locations.title: Heart Container 8
locations.description: Defeat Blind the Thief

locations.title: Heart Container 10
locations.description: Defeat Vitreous

locations.title: Heart Container 9
locations.description: Defeat Kholdstare

locations.title: Heart Container 11
locations.description: Defeat Trinexx

locations.title: Piece of Heart (1/24)
locations.description:
**Location:** In the pond next to the Swamp Ruins

Pull the lever inside the Swamp Ruins to drain the water and exit to collect the Piece of Heart.

locations.title: Piece of Heart (2/24)
locations.description:
**Location:** In a secret cave in the Lost Woods

Drop into the secret cave entrance under the bush. Exit through the hollow tree stump.

locations.title: Piece of Heart (3/24)
locations.description:
Location: In the Thieves' Hideout Basement

Bomb the cracked wall on the north wall. The Piece of Heart is inside a Treasure Chest.

locations.title: Piece of Heart (4/24)
locations.description:
**Location:** At the end of the Maze Race, southwest Hyrule

Talk to the woman and she will set you the challenge to beat the maze race in 15 seconds. Slash -- don't stab or lift -- the line of bushes going up/north, then walk to the top row and slash the bushes horizontally to the left/west and head down to the finish.

locations.title: Piece of Heart (5/24)
locations.description:
Location: Inside the Secret Cave

Bomb the crack in the wall on the north wall to access a secret corridor with pots and a chest containing the Piece of Heart.

locations.title: Piece of Heart (6/24)
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the Desert Cave

Bomb the south wall in the room with Aginah for a secret chamber with a treasure chest containing the Piece of Heart.

locations.title: Piece of Heart (7/24)
locations.description:
**Location:** In a secret cave under 

Dash into the pile of rocks using the Pegasus Boots to reveal a cave entrance. The Heart Piece is in a chest inside.

locations.title: Piece of Heart (8/24)
locations.description:
**Location:** On a rocky plateau in the Desert of Mystery

Enter the Desert Palace (using the Book of Mudora) and exit from the southwest room on B1. Follow the plateau south.

locations.title: Piece of Heart (9/24)
locations.description:
**Location:** In a small forest clearing, off the visible map

Use the Power Glove to lift the stone slab near the Witch's Hut, and continue on the path all the way to the north. Jump into the water and head east, then swim down the waterfall. Swim south and head west to find the Heart Piece.

locations.title: Piece of Heart (10/24)
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside a Death Mountain Cave

Jump off the cliff edge above the second rock balcony and go inside the cave to find the heart

locations.title: Piece of Heart (11/24)
locations.description:
**Location:** Light World, Spectacle Rock

Use the Magic Mirror when on the outline of Spectacle Rock in the Dark World to get to this unmissable heart.

locations.title: Piece of Heart (12/24)
locations.description: Walk down the right-hand side stairway in front of you, and go right along the side of the pyramid until you can jump down. The Piece of Heart is on the rightmost ledge.

locations.title: Piece of Heart (13/24)
locations.description:
**Location:** Underground in the [Hollow Tree Cave Secret Entrance](#loc=430050)

**Requirement:** Accessible after defeating Agahnim

locations.title: Piece of Heart (14/24)
locations.description: Swim to the location of this isle in the Dark World and use the Mirror to travel to the Light World

locations.title: Piece of Heart (15/24)
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the Light World Desert Plateau Cave

Step into the ring of bushes in the Dark World and use the Magic Mirror

locations.title: Piece of Heart (21/24)
locations.description: To the left of the Misery Mire dungeon entrance, enter the tree-trunk looking structure and solve the block puzzle inside.

locations.title: Piece of Heart (17/24)
locations.description: Use the Magic Mirror on the ledge in the Dark World to access this cave. Bomb the north wall.

locations.title: Piece of Heart (18/24)
locations.description:
Access this Piece of Heart via the [Death Mountain Dark World Cave](#loc=430526).
Requirements: Power Glove, Hookshot, Magic Cape

locations.title: Piece of Heart (19/24)
locations.description: Pay 30 Rupees to open two chests. The Piece of Heart is in a random chest.

locations.title: Piece of Heart (20/24)
locations.description: Pound down all the pegs nearby to open up the cave. The Piece of Heart is underground in the [Tree Trunk Cave](#loc=430867).

locations.title: Piece of Heart (22/24)
locations.description: Inside the Desert Heart Cave. Push the blocks out of the way to reach it.

locations.title: Piece of Heart (16/24)
locations.description: Found in a random location in the Digging Field

locations.title: Piece of Heart (24/24)
locations.description: Accessible only by warping from the Dark World when on the rock balcony outside of Turtle Rock.

locations.title: Piece of Heart (23/24)
locations.description: Enter via the Death Mountain Hookshot Cave in the Dark World. Find the exit to the plateau and then warp to the Light World with the Magic Mirror.

locations.title: Fighter's Sword
locations.description:
**Location:** Secret Passage, Hyrule Dungeon

Receive the Fighter's Sword from Link's Uncle in the Hyrule Castle Dungeon

locations.title: Fighter's Shield
locations.description:
**Location:** Secret Passage, Hyrule Dungeon

Receive the Fighter's Shield from Link's Uncle in the Hyrule Castle Dungeon.

locations.title: Boomerang
locations.description:
**Location:** Hyrule Castle Dungeon

The Boomerang is found in the Hyrule Castle Dungeon basement, in a treasure chest.

locations.title: Bow and Arrow
locations.description:
**Location:** 1F Large Central Room

Found in the large chest in the dungeon's biggest room. Requires the Big Key to open.

locations.title: Bug-Catching Net
locations.description:
Receive the Bug-Catching Net from the sick boy.

It can be used to catch bees and fairies and keep them in bottles.

locations.title: Ice Rod
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the Lake Hylia Ice Cave

Bomb the wall to enter. Use the Ice Rod to freeze enemies.

locations.title: Pegasus Shoes
locations.description:
**Location:** Sahasrahla's Hideout

Receive after getting the Pendant of Courage

locations.title: Flippers
locations.description:
Location: Zora's Waterfall

Walk through the river shallows in northeast Hyrule and buy the Flippers from King Zora for 500 Rupees.

locations.title: Master Sword
locations.description: Collect the three pendants to retrieve the Master Sword from the Lost Woods clearing

locations.title: Shovel
locations.description: Receive from the Transformed Flute Boy

locations.title: Flute
locations.description: The Flute Boy's ocarina is buried here. Dig it up with the Shovel.

locations.title: Magic Hammer
locations.description:
Location: Dark Palace 1F

In the long hall with the crumbling walkway, accessible via a bombable wall

locations.title: Tempered Sword
locations.description: Reunite the two Dwarven Blacksmiths. Requires finding and rescuing the [Lost Frog](#loc=430876) with the Titan's Mitt.

locations.title: Golden Sword
locations.description: Offer the Cursed Fairy your Tempered Sword

locations.title: Silver Arrows
locations.description: Offer the Cursed Fairy your Bow and Arrows

locations.title: Cane of Byrna
locations.description: Inside the [Death Mountain Dark World Treasure Cave](#loc=430892)

locations.title: Titan's Mitts
locations.description: The Titan's Mitts are found in the southwestern room on B2. With them, you can lift dark stones and slabs.

locations.title: Blue Mail
locations.description: Bomb the floor in the eastern-most room on B4 and drop down to the treasure chest on B5. Open with the Big Key

locations.title: Mirror Shield
locations.description: Enter this cave by exiting on this rock outcropping from the Turtle Rock dungeon. Use the Hookshot or the Cane of Somaria to cross the small gap and use the Big Key to open the big treasure chest there.

locations.title: Ganon's Tower
locations.description: Gather all seven Crystals to open this dungeon

locations.title: Red Mail
locations.description: Found on 1F

locations.title: Pots with Bomb Refills
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the doorless shack

Bomb the front wall to enter. Items respawn.

locations.title: Bombs
locations.description: Slam into the rocks to get a bomb refill

locations.title: Bombs (10)
locations.description: You can purchase 10 Bombs for 50 Rupees

locations.title: Bombs (4)
locations.description: Dash into the tree to make a bomb refill appear

locations.title: Super Bomb
locations.description: Purchase late in the quest to open the Cursed Fairy Fountain

locations.title: Bottle (1/4)
locations.description:
**Location:** Kakariko Village stall

Purchase for 100 Rupees

locations.title: Bottle (2/4)
locations.description:
Location: Kakariko Inn Back Room

Enter through the backdoor and find the Bottle in the chest.

locations.title: Bottle (3/4)
locations.description: **Location:** Under the bridge

locations.title: Bottle (4/4)
locations.description: Bring the [Purple Treasure Chest](#loc=430883) to the [Average Middle-Aged Man](#loc=430880) and he will open it in exchange for your silence.

locations.title: Treasure Chests (4)
locations.description:
Location: In the basement of the Thieves' Hideout

Four chests contain a Red Rupee each (80 Rupees).

locations.title: Treasure Chests (4)
locations.description:
Location: Inside the Secret Cave

Fall into the well to access the upper portion of the Secret Cave. The first treasure chest contains bombs, the other three contain one Red Rupee each (60 Rupees).

locations.title: Treasure Chests (3)
locations.description: Three chests behind a bombable wall contain Green Rupees (2x50) and bombs.

locations.title: Treasure Chest
locations.description: Contains 10 Arrows

locations.title: Treasure Chests (2)
locations.description: Enter through the [East Death Mountain Cave (Upper Entrance)](#loc=431494) and fall into the pit inside the cave, then bomb the north wall for two chests containing bombs and arrows.

locations.title: Treasure Chests (5)
locations.description: Access via the pit inside the [East Death Mountain Cave (Upper Entrance)](#loc=431494). Defeat the three Moldorms to reopen the door. Hit the switch in this room for five chests containing a Red Rupee each (100 Rupees)

locations.title: Treasure Chest (1)
locations.description: Enter through the cave entrance on the balcony above, then follow the path and drop into a pit to get to a chest with 50 Rupees

locations.title: Treasure Chests (4)
locations.description: Inside the Plains of Ruin Cave, you'll find Pikku and a bombable wall. Behind it, there are four chests with Red Rupees, for a total of 80 Rupees.

locations.title: Treasure Chest (1)
locations.description: Contains 300 Rupees

locations.title: Treasure Chest (1)
locations.description: Contains 300 Rupees

locations.title: Treasure Chests (2)
locations.description: The left one contains the Piece of Heart while the right one holds a Red Rupee (50).

locations.title: Treasure Chests (4)
locations.description: Inside the Death Mountain Hookshot Cave. Each contains 50 Ruppes, for a total of 200.

locations.title: Purple Treasure Chest
locations.description: The key to the chest is locked inside. You have to bring it to the [Average Middle-Aged Man](#loc=430880) to unlock it. It contains a Bottle.

locations.title: Treasure Chest (4)
locations.description: Four treasure chests with Rupees, bombs, and arrows

locations.title: Lamp
locations.description:
**Location:** Link's House, in a Chest

The Lamp is in the treasure chest in the lower right corner. Use it light torches or burn things.

locations.title: Pendant of Courage
locations.description:
**Location:** Boss Chamber, 1F Northern Room

Defeat the Easter Palace Boss to receive one of three pendants, the Pendant of Courage.

locations.title: Eastern Palace Big Key
locations.description:
**Location:** 1F, West

Destroy all enemies in the room to make the Bubble Group scatter. You can now open the treasure chest in the north half.

locations.title: Hyrule Castle Dungeon Big Key
locations.description:
**Location:** Hyrule Dungeon, defeat the Ball and Chain Trooper

The Big Key is used to unlock Zelda's cell.

locations.title: Mushroom
locations.description:
**Location:** Mushroom locations are randomized

Bring the Mushroom to the Witch in Eastern Hyrule.

locations.title: Book of Mudora
locations.description:
**Location:** On a shelf inside the Library

Use the Pegasus Shoes to slam into the shelf and make it drop. The book translates ancient Hylian.

locations.title: Pendant of Wisdom
locations.description: Defeat Moldorm

locations.title: Magical Boomerang
locations.description: Toss the Boomerang in the Mysterious Pond

locations.title: Red Shield
locations.description: Toss the Fighter's Shield in the Mysterious Pond

locations.title: Ether Medallion
locations.description:
**Location:** Across the bridge, inside the stone pedestal

Use the Book of Mudora to read the Hylian text, then raise the Master Sword.

locations.title: Quake Medallion
locations.description: Throw anything (rock, bush, bomb, etc.) into the Circle of Stones and the Catfish will come out and give you the Quake Medallion.

locations.title: Dark Palace Big Key
locations.description: Location: Dark Palace 1F

locations.title: Dark Palace Crystal
locations.description:
**Location:** Dark Palace B1

Defeat the boss

locations.title: Bombos Medallion
locations.description: Use the Magic Mirror nearby in the Dark World's [Light World Plateau Access Point](#loc=430171) to access the plateau. Read the Hylian Plaque with the Book of Mudora.

locations.title: Magic Cape
locations.description: Enter the Hidden Crypt by pushing the tomb stone (using the [Titan's Mitts](#loc=430898)) and collect the Cape from the treasure chest inside.

locations.title: Hookshot
locations.description: Inside the big chest in the large, waterlogged room

locations.title: Skull Woods Crystal
locations.description: Defeat Mothula

locations.title: Fire Rod
locations.description: Inside the big chest in this entrance room (but not accessible until after exploring the various areas, getting the [Skull Woods Big Key](#loc=430796) and triggering a switch).

locations.title: Skull Woods Big Key
locations.description: Pull the statue onto the switch to enter the room with the chest containing the key

locations.title: Swamp Palace Crystal
locations.description: Defeat Arrghus

locations.title: Thieves' Town Big Key
locations.description: The Thieves' Town Big Key is in a treasure chest on the B1 entry hall, accessible from the room to the east.

locations.title: Thieves' Town Crystal
locations.description: Defeat Blind the Thief

locations.title: Good Bee
locations.description: Dash into the statue inside the Fairy Fountain to release the Good Bee. Catch it with your net to store it in a Bottle. When released, the Good Bee will attack Link's foes.

locations.title: Misery Mire Big Key
locations.description: Expand a room on 1F and drop into a pit to land on a B1 room with the key in the southeast corner of the dungeon.

locations.title: Cane of Somaria
locations.description: Found on B1 at the end of a crumbling pathway

locations.title: Misery Mire Crystal
locations.description: Defeat Vitreous

locations.title: Ice Palace Big Key
locations.description: In the western-most room on B1. Accessible via the stairs from B2.

locations.title: Ice Palace Crystal
locations.description: Defeat Kholdstare

locations.title: Turtle Rock Crystal
locations.description: Defeat Trinexx

locations.title: Ganon's Tower Big Key
locations.description: Found on B1

locations.title: Magic Powder
locations.description: Give the Mushroom to the Witch and exit the area and come back to receive the Magic Powder.

locations.title: Magic Mirror
locations.description: While exploring the Death Mountain Cave, you'll run into an old man, who you need to guide higher up into the mountain. To thank you, he gives you the Magic Mirror.

locations.title: Red Rupee
locations.description: Slam into the tree with your Pegasus Boots (late game)

locations.title: Rupees (300)
locations.description: Receive from Piku

locations.title: Rupees (300)
locations.description: Underground, inside Hyrule Castle Sewers Treasure Room

locations.title: 4x Blue Rupees (20)
locations.description: Pull on the Turtle Rock claw

locations.title: Treasure Chest (2)
locations.description: Push the blocks aside to get Bombs and a Red Rupee. Accessible from the entrance to the [East Death Mountain Dark World Cave](#loc=431500) above. The skull pot nearby contains a Magic Ampule.

locations.title: Blue Rupee (5)
locations.description: Smash into the tree with the Pegasus Shoes (early game).

locations.title: Boss: Armos Knights
locations.description:
**Location:** Boss Chamber, 1F Northern Room

A group of six hopping Armos Knights is found in the Boss Chamber. The easiest way to dispatch them is to equip your Bow and Arrow and shoot each of them three times.

locations.title: Ball and Chain Trooper
locations.description:
**Location:** Hyrule Castle Dungeon Jail

The Ball and Chain Trooper acts as a boss for the dungeon. Use pots to easily take him out from a distance.

locations.title: Boss: Moldorm
locations.description: Use your sword and strike him at the end of his tail to damage him. Each time you hit him, he'll get faster and more aggressive with his movements. Stay way from the edges, jeep moving, and get him in his tail when he circles around to go the other way.

locations.title: Boss: Agahnim
locations.description: Face Agahnim on 7F after getting the Master Sword from the Lost Woods.

locations.title: Boss: Helmasaur King
locations.description:
**Location:** Dark Palace B1

Destroy the head armor with the Magic Hammer, then slash at the jewel in his head

locations.title: Boss: Arrghus
locations.description: Use your Hookshot to grab the balls that surround him (and shield him), killing each of them individually. Then slash at the cyclops jellyfish as it comes for you.

locations.title: Boss: Mothula
locations.description: Vulnerable to fire. Use the Fire Rod.

locations.title: Boss: Blind the Thief
locations.description: Expose the Maiden to light to reveal this boss. Slash at him and his heads with the sword while avoiding the beams and collisions.

locations.title: Boss: Vitreous
locations.description: Slash at the eyes of this dungeon boss while avoiding its lightning attacks. The last phase is the eyeball hopping around -- sword attacks will defeat it easily.

locations.title: Boss: Kholdstare
locations.description: Defeat with the Fire Rod

locations.title: Toppo (Only Appear up to Dark World Discovery)
locations.description: Only appear early in Link's quest.

locations.title: Boss: Trinexx
locations.description: Defeat by stunning its Fire and Ice heads with the Ice and Fire Rods, respectively, then attacking with the Sword. The final head/form is taken down with the Sword.

locations.title: Boss: Agahnim II
locations.description: Hit his energy balls back at him using the Sword or Bug-Catching Net. Fake copies of the wizard have a lighter-colored shadow.

locations.title: Fish Rescue Secret
locations.description: Drain the water in the Swamp Ruins to make a fish appear. Carry it up to the pond and toss it into the dark blue waters. You'll get a Red Rupee for your kindness.

locations.title: Cracked Wall
locations.description: Bomb the wall to reunite the Quarreling Brothers

locations.title: Obstacle Course: Maze Race
locations.description: Talk to the woman and then finish the race in 15 seconds or less to win a Piece of Heart.

locations.description: Enter through this door to get to the treasure inside

locations.title: 1/2 Magic Power
locations.description: Upgrade your magic meter by sprinkling Magic Powder on the [Mad Batter Altar](#loc=430491)

locations.title: Sahasrahla
locations.description: Meet up with the Elder Sahasrahla as part of the main quest.

locations.title: Loyal Sage
locations.description: Meet the Loyal Sage after rescuing Zelda to receive your next quest marker.

locations.title: Shasrahla's Wife
locations.description: The Elder's wife provides hints as to his location and other quest support.

locations.title: Boy (Cucco Pen)
locations.description: The Boy is waiting near the cucco pen. He will provide a location for Sahasrahla.

locations.title: Older Quarreling Brother
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the long house in southwest Hyrule

locations.title: Younger Quarreling Brother
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the long house in southwest Hyrule

locations.title: Woman (Maze Race)
locations.description: Talk to the woman and she will set you the challenge to beat the maze race in 15 seconds. Slash -- don't stab or lift -- the line of bushes going up, then walk to the top row and slash the bushes horizontally to the left and head down to the finish.

locations.title: Man (Maze Race)
locations.description: Talk to the man (by running into him) at the end of the race to get your completion time. If it's exactly or below 15 seconds, you win the prize.

locations.title: Aginah
locations.description: The Elder Aginah tells you about the fate of the seven wise men in the Golden Land.

locations.title: Street Merchant
locations.description: Sells you a Bottle

locations.title: Bug-Catching Kid
locations.description: This sick boy is asleep in his bed. Wake him to get the Bug-Catching Net.

locations.title: Witch
locations.description: The Witch will create the Magic Powder for you if you bring her a Mushroom from the Lost Woods

locations.title: Shopkeeper / Maple
locations.description:
This Potion Shop features three potions:

Red Potion: 120 Rupees
Green Potion: 60 Rupees
Blue Potion: 160 Rupees

The shopkeeper in the GBA version is Maple

locations.title: Camper
locations.description:
Location: Under the Bridge

Talk to the camper who is dozing in front of his tent to receive a Bottle.

locations.title: Bully and his Friend
locations.description: Once human, the Bully and his friend are transformed into an Oni and a ball-shaped creature

locations.title: Catfish
locations.description: The Catfish who resides in the Circle of Stones put up a sign nearby to tell you NOT to throw anything into the ring.

locations.title: Storyteller Tree
locations.description: Talk to the transformed hermit to learn about the Golden Power (the Triforce).

locations.title: Storyteller Bird
locations.description: Pay the Storyteller 20 Rupees for a hint.

locations.title: Flute Boy's Father
locations.description: Talk to him after receiving the Flute to get a hint on how to use it (and confirmation that you can keep it)

locations.title: Tavern Guest
locations.description: This old man tells you about the Waterfall of Wishing

locations.title: Cucco Woman
locations.description: Sprinkle Magic Powder on the Cucco found under the pot in this house to turn it into a human woman. She will tell you that the weathercock helps Cuccos take revenge on those that attack them.

locations.title: Pikku (Friendly)
locations.description: Talk to him to receive 300 Rupees

locations.title: Fortune Teller
locations.description: Pay between 10 and 30 Rupees to get a hint. Also refills your hearts.

locations.title: Fortune Teller
locations.description: Pay between 10 and 30 Rupees to get a hint. Also refills your hearts.

locations.title: Storyteller Insect
locations.description: Pay 20 Rupees to get a hint.

locations.title: Lost Frog
locations.description: The Lost Frog is the transformed Dark World version of one of the two Dwarven Blacksmiths. Find him south of the Village of Outcasts behind a row of dark skull rocks (Titan's Mitt required) and reunite him with his partner at the Smithy in the Light World.

locations.title: Average Middle-Aged Man
locations.description:
This mysterious character won't talk to you until after you've acquired the Titan's Mitt and you've brought along the [Purple Treasure Chest](#loc=430883) in the Dark World. 

He will now admit to being a former thief and will open the chest in exchange for your silence.

locations.title: Lost Old Man
locations.description: The Old Man, once rescued from the caves, will replenish your hearts when you talk to him.

locations.title: Sweeping Grandma
locations.description: Only found early in the quest. Sprinkle Magic Powder on her to turn her into a Fairy.

locations.title: Running Kid
locations.description: Use the Pegasus Shoes to catch up with him and you can talk to him. He'll just provide a basic tip: dash into trees to get items.

locations.title: Flower Ring Transfer Point
locations.description: Step into the circle and warp to the Light World to access the [Desert Plateau Cave](#loc=430151) via the [Transfer Point](#loc=434757)

locations.title: Light World Plateau Access Point
locations.description: Use the Magic Mirror while inside the area with the pegs to be able to get to the Light World plateau [Transition Point](#loc=434740) with the Hylian Plaque and [Bombos Medallion](#loc=430170).

locations.title: Hookshot Traversal Point
locations.description: Use the Hookshot to get to the other side to the [Transition Point](#loc=434746)

locations.title: Desert Heart Cave Access Point
locations.description:
Warp to the Light World to get on top of the plateau with the entrance to the [Desert Heart Cave](#loc=430870)

Grants access to this Light World [Transition Point](#loc=434744)

locations.title: Death Mountain Dark World Treasure Cave Access
locations.description: Drop from the opening in the raised ledge

locations.title: Light World Isle Access Point
locations.description: Use the Magic Mirror here to access the isle at the Light World [Transfer Point](#loc=434754)

locations.title: Transition Point
locations.description: Warp to this plateau via the Magic Mirror in the Light World, from the [Light World Plateau Access Point](#loc=430171)

locations.title: Transition Point

locations.title: Transition Point

locations.title: Transition Point

locations.title: Transition Point

locations.title: Hookshot Transfer Point
